source: Averianov & Lopatin 2021, Journal of Systematic Palaeontology 19: 1097-1128, Fig. 23: part of the single most parsimonious tree from TNT, Alvarezsauroidea; each node drawn as a fork (a diagonal up to the upper child and a diagonal down to a horizontal leading to the lower child), node numbers above the forks, two bold clade names. Image: census figure (2044x1188 px).

names_note: the paper's matrix taxa (census list, 115 taxa; the figure shows the alvarezsauroid part); tips take the matrix spelling: the figure prints 'Shishugounykus inexpectus' and 'Nemegtonicus citus' for the matrix's Shishugounykus and Nemegtonykus citus
gold_note: Alvarezsauroid part of the tree, 20 tips, fully resolved; drawn as diagonal forks rather than rectangular elbows. The bold numbers are node numbers, not support. Random-sample case (seed 20261106). Topology transcribed from the figure and checked node by node; topology only.
